chapters.title: A growing program set, and a hard path to the answer

children.text: Caron aims to transform lives impacted by addiction and substance use through proven, comprehensive and personalized behavioral healthcare solutions. The Caron team needed to improve the patient journey and adapt to the changes of Caron’s offerings by simplifying and streamlining access to critical information on their website and making the experience more engaging. They needed an implementation partner who could weave together a design and technology solution designed to scale quickly across all touchpoints.

chapters.title: Simpler navigation, clearer ways to make contact

children.text: Starting with a deep assessment of Caron experience through patient, family and referring professional interviews, we simplified navigation system to create easy access to Caron’s robust program and service architecture. We created easier and direct access to critical information through a conversion-centric design focused on making contact opportunities clear across all channels. The technical solution ties together content and marketing needs that helps to communicate the right message at the right time. Through ongoing data and insight assessments, we have defined key areas of opportunity and are able to deliver continued success for Caron.
